name: CAR' UMER
source:
The Czar is Dead is a visual novel in the setting of the Russian Empire. Help the last Russian emperor save his soul, life and country.

The game describes the events of an alternative history.
What would have happened if Great Russia had won the First World War?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2799560/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《沙皇已死》是一部以俄罗斯帝国为背景的视觉小说。帮助最后一位俄罗斯皇帝拯救他的灵魂、生命和国家。

游戏描述了另类历史的事件。
如果大俄罗斯赢得第一次世界大战会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2799560/]Steam[/url]]
